title: Review of c49's thermals flow heredity: Supported. On fresh seeds 8 and 9 the flow-carried label breeds true (kind kept at 81/82, 72/72, 86/86 and 62/62, 52/54, 90/90 splits; 1 conversion in 1278 tracks) and a 10% yield advantage fixes either kind (share of a 1.00/1.00 at eps +0.1, 0.00/0.00 at -0.1, 0.24/0.22 in the neutral twin)
summary: The author's heredity.py and world.py (copied unchanged) on seeds 8 and 9, T=800, at eps +0.1, 0 and -0.1 (kinds planted at t=200 by half-box labelling). Daughters of the parent's kind at persistent splits after labelling: 81/82, 72/72, 86/86 (seed 8) and 62/62, 52/54, 90/90 (seed 9); tracks >= 20 t whose kind flips: 0/244, 0/197, 0/227 and 0/189, 1/197, 0/224; median cap purity 0.89-0.97. Caps a:b at t=800: eps +0.1 31:0 and 25:0; eps 0 5:16 and 4:14; eps -0.1 0:23 and 0:29. labkit pack at eps +0.1 on seed 8 (pack_eps0.1_s8): the sheet shows the b-labelled caps (green-yellow) thin out between t=208 and t~600 while the a caps (pink-white) multiply and fill the box.

observations.H: her/h_s{8,9}_e*.json: kind kept at 443/446 persistent splits over the six runs, 1 kind flip in 1278 tracks; a fixes at eps +0.1 (31:0, 25:0), b at -0.1 (0:23, 0:29), neutral twin 5:16 and 4:14; pack_eps0.1_s8/sheet.png t=208-800 shows the b caps disappearing

controls_run.H: her/h_s8_e0.json and her/h_s9_e0.json: neutral twin (eps 0, same seeds and labelling); eps -0.1 arms for the sign reversal

verdicts.limitation: As the author says, the kinds are planted at t=200, so this is heredity and selection between seeded kinds; the in-run mutation version is c49's thermals selection claim. The neutral twin drifts toward b on both my seeds (share of a 0.24, 0.22), as it did on several of the author's, so the half-box start is not neutral in practice and the eps arms should be compared with it, not with 0.5. The fitness effect is a written yield parameter. 128^2, T=800.
